skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply marketing principles in service industries, including customer behavior, service management, and marketing mix.
Analyze customer behavior in service contexts, including risk perception and satisfaction.
Manage service operations, including quality measurement and balancing supply and demand.
Develop and implement service strategies, including product, pricing, distribution, and promotion decisions.
Design and improve service processes and customer experiences.
Communicate effectively in both written and oral formats, working independently and in teams.
Understand and apply ethical and social responsibility in service marketing.
Integrate knowledge and experience to solve business and marketing problems in service contexts.
